mapper.select: SELECT p.* FROM `t_road_acceptance_ledger` p WHERE ORDER BY p.`ledger_no`, p.`id`
SELECT p.* FROM `t_road_acceptance_ledger` p WHERE ORDER BY p.`ledger_no`, p.`id`

SELECT COUNT(1) AS `total`, SUM(CASE WHEN p.`source_facility_id` IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `migratedCount`, SUM(CASE WHEN p.`source_facility_id` IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `manualCount`, SUM(CASE WHEN p.`remark` LIKE '迁移提示%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `orphanCount`, SUM(CASE WHEN p.`material_count` = 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `fullMaterialCount`, SUM(CASE WHEN p.`material_count` = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `emptyMaterialCount` FROM `t_road_acceptance_ledger` p WHERE
SELECT p.`status` AS `status`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_road_acceptance_ledger` p WHERE GROUP BY p.`status` ORDER BY `count` DESC

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.`${column}`, ''), #{emptyLabel}) AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_road_acceptance_ledger` p WHERE GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(p.`${column}`, ''), #{emptyLabel}) ORDER BY `count` DESC

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.`ledger_no`, '-', 2), '-', -1) AS `name`, COUNT(1) AS `count` FROM `t_road_acceptance_ledger` p WHERE p.`ledger_no` LIKE 'YS-%' AND GROUP BY SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.`ledger_no`, '-', 2), '-', -1) ORDER BY `name`

SELECT SUM(p.`has_sgxk`) AS `hasSgxk`, SUM(p.`has_ysbg`) AS `hasYsbg`, SUM(p.`has_jgtc`) AS `hasJgtc`, SUM(p.`has_zljdbg`) AS `hasZljdbg`, SUM(p.`has_cljybg`) AS `hasCljybg`, SUM(p.`has_ajbg`) AS `hasAjbg`, SUM(p.`has_ghyshgz`) AS `hasGhyshgz`, SUM(p.`has_jgbaba`) AS `hasJgbaba`, SUM(p.`has_dazxys`) AS `hasDazxys`, SUM(p.`has_dlyjd`) AS `hasDlyjd`, SUM(p.`has_yhxy`) AS `hasYhxy`, SUM(p.`has_jgwj`) AS `hasJgwj`, SUM(p.`has_yjwj`) AS `hasYjwj` FROM `t_road_acceptance_ledger` p WHERE

SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(p.`ledger_no`, CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM `t_road_acceptance_ledger` p WHERE p.`ledger_no` LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%') AND CHAR_LENGTH(p.`ledger_no`) = CHAR_LENGTH(#{prefix}) + 4
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `t_archive` a WHERE a.`del_flag` = 0 AND a.`id` = #{archiveId}
